state_analysis: The analysis_report.txt file has been created. Now I need to create the optimized_logrotate.conf and rotation_summary.csv files.
explanation: Creating the optimized logrotate configuration file and the rotation summary CSV file.

commands.keystrokes:
cat > /app/optimized_logrotate.conf << 'EOF'
# Optimized Logrotate Configuration
# Generated by Log Rotation Analyzer
# Implements daily rotation with compression for all log files

# Global defaults
# compress: Enable compression for rotated files
# delaycompress: Don't compress the most recent rotated file (allows easy access)
# missingok: Don't error if log file is missing
# notifempty: Don't rotate empty files
# create: Create new log file after rotation with specified permissions

# Access Log - High traffic, medium importance
# Growth rate: 45.7 MB/day, Retention: 14 days
/var/log/samples/access.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 50M
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload nginx > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
    endscript
}

# Application Log - Critical for debugging, high importance
# Growth rate: 12.5 MB/day, Retention: 30 days
/var/log/samples/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root root
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 25M
    copytruncate
}

# System Log - Critical for audit trail, high importance
# Growth rate: 25.3 MB/day, Retention: 90 days
/var/log/samples/system.log {
    daily
    rotate 90
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root adm
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 50M
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl kill -s HUP rsyslog.service > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
    endscript
}

# Error Log - Critical importance, compliance required
# Growth rate: 8.9 MB/day, Retention: 60 days
/var/log/samples/error.log {
    daily
    rotate 60
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 20M
    copytruncate
}

# Debug Log - Low importance, short retention
# Growth rate: 5.3 MB/day, Retention: 7 days
/var/log/samples/debug.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    maxsize 15M
    copytruncate
}
EOF
